conscientiousness.medium: You balance structure with flexibility, achieving goals while adapting to changes.
conscientiousness.low: You prefer spontaneity and flexibility over rigid planning and structure.

agreeableness.low: You value directness and objectivity, prioritizing results over social harmony.

emotionalStability.low: You experience emotions deeply and may be more sensitive to stress.
